name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Between Pipeline and Reactor, one goes with Otis and the other with Watt.
Exactly one of these is true: Diesel goes with Pipeline; Diesel goes with Reactor; Otis goes with Civil.
Either Watt goes with Bridge or Diesel goes with Mechanical.
Pipeline goes with at least one of Diesel, Civil, or Mechanical.

hints.text: Suppose Diesel went with Pipeline — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Diesel goes with Pipeline.
Pipeline goes with Diesel, so Otis can't go with Pipeline.
Pipeline goes with Diesel, so Watt can't go with Pipeline.
…but now the clue “Between Pipeline and Reactor, one goes with Otis and the other with Watt” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Diesel does not go with Pipeline.

hints.text: Suppose Diesel didn't go with Bridge — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Diesel does not go with Bridge.
In Engineer × Project, Diesel must go with Reactor — every other Project is already crossed out for it.
Reactor goes with Diesel, so Otis can't go with Reactor.
Reactor goes with Diesel, so Watt can't go with Reactor.
…but now the clue “Between Pipeline and Reactor, one goes with Otis and the other with Watt” can no longer hold — a contradiction.

hints.text: Diesel goes with Bridge, so it can't also go with Reactor.
Bridge goes with Diesel, so Otis can't go with Bridge.
Bridge goes with Diesel, so Watt can't go with Bridge.
From the clue “Exactly one of these is true: Diesel goes with Pipeline; Diesel goes with Reactor; Otis goes with Civil” — Otis must go with Civil.
Civil goes with Otis, so Diesel can't go with Civil.
Otis goes with Civil, so it can't also go with Mechanical.
Otis goes with Civil, so it can't also go with Structural.
Civil goes with Otis, so Watt can't go with Civil.
Bridge goes with Diesel, but Civil doesn't, so Civil doesn't go with Bridge.
From the clue “Either Watt goes with Bridge or Diesel goes with Mechanical” — Diesel must go with Mechanical.
Diesel goes with Mechanical, so it can't also go with Structural.
Mechanical goes with Diesel, so Watt can't go with Mechanical.
In Engineer × Discipline, Structural must go with Watt — every other Engineer is already crossed out for it.
Mechanical goes with Diesel, and Bridge goes with Diesel, so Mechanical goes with Bridge.
Mechanical goes with Diesel, but Pipeline doesn't, so Mechanical doesn't go with Pipeline.
Mechanical goes with Diesel, but Reactor doesn't, so Mechanical doesn't go with Reactor.
Bridge goes with Diesel, but Structural doesn't, so Structural doesn't go with Bridge.
From the clue “Pipeline goes with at least one of Diesel, Civil, or Mechanical” — Civil must go with Pipeline.
Civil goes with Pipeline, so it can't also go with Reactor.
Pipeline goes with Civil, so Structural can't go with Pipeline.
In Discipline × Project, Reactor must go with Structural — every other Discipline is already crossed out for it.
Otis goes with Civil, and Pipeline goes with Civil, so Otis goes with Pipeline.
Otis goes with Civil, but Reactor doesn't, so Otis doesn't go with Reactor.
Pipeline goes with Civil, but Watt doesn't, so Watt doesn't go with Pipeline.
Watt goes with Structural, and Reactor goes with Structural, so Watt goes with Reactor.
